newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Azomures keeps Bucharest bourse buoyant.
newsitem.headline: Azomures keeps Bucharest bourse buoyant.

text.p: Lively trading in Azomures SA fertiliser maker pushed Bucharest bourse turnover 10 million lei higher to 816.3 million on Thursday.
Azomures took 90 percent of turnover and closed 2,700 lei up at 29,900. Brokers said most of its 242 trades had been cross deals, introduced last month in a bid to boost turnover.

Traders said Azomures buy notes accumulated in the market for weeks were behind its higher price rather than news of its privatisation after the State Ownership Fund sold a 51 percent stake in it to a Romanian trading company.
"Azomures supply has been thin for weeks and buying orders have amassed. Hadn't the market had the news of the 51 percent sale, its price would have gone up anyway," said a trader.
"The sale will affect the market later, after brokers and investors digest the news," he added.
Higher prices of Azomures and Carbid-Fox carbide maker -- which brokers say account for the bulk of market capitalisation -- sent two independent indices to year highs.

Carbid-Fox traded more than one third the 74,376 shares which changed hands on Thursday and closed 80 lei stronger at 1,370. But it contributed only 40 million lei to total turnover due to its low price.
Engineering company Artrom SA, which traders say is one of the most liquid stocks on the exchange, had 50.7 million lei in turnover and closed 100 lei higher at 3,150.
Most other stocks drifted lower amid thin demand. One stock had no trade and syringe maker Sanevit SA remained suspended pending an announcement on its new capital base.
Two unofficial indices - the VAB and the BIG -- rose by 5.7 percent and respectively 5.66 percent on the previous session.
Prices are on MRRO and MRRP
